alexcrichton opened PR #15283 from alexcrichton:big-fibers to bytecodealliance:main:

An unchecked addition here could panic in debug mode and would silently wrap around in release mode. In release mode this would always wrap to 0 given previous alignment conditions and mmap-ing 0 bytes is always an error. This changes the addition to a checked addition to clarify the error coming out and additionally ensure there's no panic with overflow checks.
